correctness.rationale: For two named equivalence relations E and F on nonempty finite universes, the rank-two first-order sentence theory is exactly the set of pointed rank-one atomic witness masks; the EF two-pebble back-and-forth argument proves this without a bounded-size assumption. A 4-point complete 2x2 incidence grid has commuting composites, while a 6-point cycle does not, yet both realize mask (120). The defining biconditional ∀x∀y[(∃z E(x,z)∧F(z,y))↔(∃z F(x,z)∧E(z,y))] has rank 3. Complete restricted-growth enumeration of all 44168 ordered partition pairs of carrier sizes 1..6 (independently reproduced in audit code) proves no opposite-status mask collision for total size<10 and precisely (4,6):(120), (6,4):(56,120),(88,120) at total 10. The proof separately excludes noncommuting structures ≤3 from sharing any commuting mask, covering all omitted asymmetric size pairs. The finite enumeration is exhaustive only for the stated bounded sizes; the EF equivalence and size cutoff are analytic.
